::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Janry 26—1891  
**From:** The Edge, Tooting Common.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA collection 100 box 119/6
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
I hope you will be able to get [‘At the Fair’](other_books/otherbook_643.qmd) into the May no. July is <u>such</u> a long time off.

Very truly yours
[Katharine S. MacQuoid](people/person_943.qmd)
